event_basis: ordered fixation catalogue from the selected open detector
temporal_rule: adjacent fixation episodes must have non-negative inter-fixation gap; overlapping sequences are non-evaluable
missing_assignment_rule: both adjacent fixations must have AOI assignment; an unassigned fixation breaks the chain
interpretation: Counts changes between directly adjacent AOI-assigned fixations. This is the common open/reproducible operationalization across detector branches.
Source describes transitions as saccades from one AOI to another. Retain as historical reference; do not claim identity with the adjacent-fixation open operationalization.

estimand: Prompt vs Non-prompt raw transition-count ratio
interpretation: Mixes process behavior with exposure duration and must not enter the primary transition-rate robustness denominator.
